title: Sorting Through Value
summary: Reassessing lagging holdings and policy transmission.
coverage_note: Read every section and chart label, including macro, Mt. Gox, crypto politics/Nostr, CVS, BMY, Bank OZK and EM rotation.

claims.claim: Domestic liquidity stays rangebound.
claims.reason: A bounded-range prediction needs explicit tolerance and the original proxy. The source provides no numerical breakout threshold.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.
claims.next_check: Reconstruct source liquidity measure through September 2024.

claims.claim: Foreign cuts foreshadow eventual Fed easing.
claims.reason: The Fed began easing September 18. Foreign decisions did not determine the U.S. decision; domestic inflation and employment evidence remained central.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: September 2024 FOMC statement
evidence.finding: The Fed cut its target by 50 basis points to 4.75-5.00%, while describing inflation as still elevated and continuing securities runoff.

claims.claim: Bank earnings cushion unrealized losses.
claims.reason: Retained profits can rebuild capital, while aggregate unrealized losses do not identify individual failure risk. OZK later remained profitable despite property losses; this is one bank, not a system-wide proof.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: Bank OZK 2025 earnings
evidence.finding: 2025 net income was $699.3 million versus $700.3 million in 2024; EPS reached $6.18 and net interest income $1.59 billion.

evidence.title: Bank OZK 2025 Form 10-K
evidence.finding: 2025 RESG charge-offs included Baltimore land $25.5 m, Boston office $72.4 m, Santa Monica office $5.7 m and Chicago life-science property $14.1 m.

claims.next_check: Track FDIC capital and loss distribution, not just aggregate totals.

claims.claim: Bank fragility limits further rate hikes.
claims.reason: A soft ceiling is not quantified and can be relaxed by emergency liquidity tools. Later cuts do not prove banks forced them.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

claims.claim: Cooling labor favors mild late-year cuts.
claims.reason: Timing and direction matched, but the initial move was 50 basis points rather than a small 25-point step. The source was conditional on further labor softening.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: September 2024 FOMC statement
evidence.finding: The Fed cut its target by 50 basis points to 4.75-5.00%, while describing inflation as still elevated and continuing securities runoff.

claims.next_check: Compare size and cumulative easing with the original mild scenario.

claims.claim: Surveys expose uneven labor conditions.
claims.reason: Household and establishment surveys measure different populations and are revised differently. Divergence alone does not identify which measure is correct.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.
claims.next_check: Reconcile payroll revisions, household controls and multiple-jobholder adjustments.

claims.claim: Mortgage lock-in blunts easing stimulus.
claims.reason: The year-end mortgage rate stayed far above outstanding low-rate loans, supporting the channel. It does not establish the size of the aggregate consumption effect.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: Mortgage rates continue to rise
evidence.finding: The 30-year mortgage survey rate was 6.85%, far above the 2021 refinancing trough despite 2024 Fed rate cuts.

claims.next_check: Measure refinance applications and household payment savings.

claims.claim: Cuts favor EM, gold and bitcoin.
claims.reason: These are separate assets with different exposures. Matched return windows and a causal counterfactual are needed; gold or bitcoin appreciation alone cannot validate the whole bundle.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.
claims.next_check: Compare each asset after September easing, with dollar and growth controls.

claims.claim: Bitcoin ETF inflows have resumed.
claims.reason: The independent daily net-flow series confirms the report-date observation that inflows resumed in the second half of May. This is an empirical confirmation, not a new price forecast.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: U.S. spot bitcoin ETF daily net flows
evidence.finding: All trading days May 15-June 7 2024 had positive aggregate net flows; June 4 reached +$886.6 m.

claims.claim: Mt. Gox failure advanced self-custody.
claims.reason: The sequence is plausible, but hardware-wallet growth also reflects prices and other exchange failures.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.
claims.next_check: Compare dated wallet adoption and customer motivations with competing shocks.

claims.claim: Mt. Gox distributions arrive in 2024.
claims.reason: The trustee announced BTC/BCH repayments had begun on July 5 2024, within the stated calendar year. This verifies distributions commencing, not completion of all claims or the size of creditor selling.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: Repayment announcement
evidence.finding: BTC/BCH repayments began through designated exchanges on July 5 2024.

claims.claim: Creditors sell a minority of coins.
claims.reason: The less-than-20-30% estimate is attributed to other analysts and adopted cautiously. Exchange transfers cannot reveal actual beneficiary sales reliably.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.
claims.next_check: Use creditor sales or exchange execution evidence, not wallet transfers alone.

claims.claim: Distribution pressure is intermediate-term noise.
claims.reason: Minor and priced-in have no quantified drawdown or recovery threshold; a later rally cannot establish that the supply event had no material impact.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

claims.claim: Crypto gains bipartisan political influence.
claims.reason: A veto and campaign promises are not enacted policy. The claimed influence requires tracing votes, donations and actual legal changes.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.
claims.next_check: Compare congressional votes and enacted crypto provisions, excluding unfulfilled promises.

claims.claim: Open social protocols preserve user control.
claims.reason: Client portability can reduce platform dependence, but discovery, relays, moderation and key custody retain power centers. The report offers architecture and advocacy, not a dated adoption target.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.claim: Lightning integrates social micropayments.
claims.reason: Technical interoperability can exist without sustained user adoption or superior economics.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.
claims.next_check: Verify client implementations and actual non-incentivized payment activity.

claims.claim: Structural deterioration distinguishes value traps.
claims.reason: This is a decision rule. Applying it needs explicit invalidation thresholds, otherwise weak performance can be indefinitely relabeled temporary.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.claim: CVS integration supports shareholder returns.
claims.reason: 2025 adjusted earnings improved, but the large care-delivery goodwill impairment directly challenges purchase-price and synergy assumptions. Operational recovery does not erase capital-allocation loss.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: CVS Health 2025 results
evidence.finding: Adjusted EPS recovered from $5.42 to $6.75 and health-insurance adjusted operating income from $307 m to $2,939 m; a $5.7 bn care-delivery goodwill impairment undercuts the acquisition-synergy premise.

claims.next_check: Compare cumulative acquisition cash costs, impairments, debt reduction and cash distributions.

claims.claim: CVS insurance problems are temporary.
claims.reason: Insurance adjusted earnings recovered substantially in 2025 after a weak 2024, supporting a cyclical component. Broader acquisition impairment means the whole company problem was not merely temporary utilization.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: CVS Health 2025 results
evidence.finding: Adjusted EPS recovered from $5.42 to $6.75 and health-insurance adjusted operating income from $307 m to $2,939 m; a $5.7 bn care-delivery goodwill impairment undercuts the acquisition-synergy premise.

claims.next_check: Track normalized medical-cost ratios and consolidated cash returns beyond one rebound year.

claims.claim: CVS may be forming a bottom.
claims.reason: The tentative bottom did not hold: CVS closed below the prior 2024 closing low on November 15. The low-conviction wording is retained, and the later positive total return does not rescue that timing call.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: CVS bottom check
evidence.finding: Minimum raw daily close January 1-June 9, 2024: May 28 $53.630001. First subsequent lower close November 15, 2024 $53.189999. This is a dated raw price-floor test, separate from dividend-reinvested returns.

claims.claim: BMY faces a genuine patent cliff.
claims.reason: The later Legacy Portfolio contraction confirms the business risk; Growth Portfolio gains also show the company was not simply in irreversible decline.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: Bristol Myers Squibb 2025 results
evidence.finding: Growth Portfolio revenue rose from $22.563 bn to $26.409 bn while Legacy Portfolio fell from $25.737 bn to $21.785 bn; aggregate revenue was approximately flat.

claims.claim: BMY may be undervalued despite risk.
claims.reason: The author is explicitly mixed, with no deadline for rerating. A sub-7 x FCF multiple is a valuation input, not proof of a bargain.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

claims.claim: BMY payout supports a cautious hold.
claims.reason: Dividend safety requires operating cash after acquisitions, debt and pipeline spending. Credit rating and stated yield alone are incomplete.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.
claims.next_check: Reconcile BMY dividends, cash flow and leverage through 2025.

claims.claim: OZK discount compensates for CRE risk.
claims.reason: A low multiple may or may not compensate for concentrated tail losses. Later strong EPS and property charge-offs point in opposing directions; neither settles fair value.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

claims.reason: The historical relationship needs return/currency decomposition and commodity/global-growth controls; cheap purchasing-power estimates do not set reversal timing.

claims.reason: The Fed did ease in September 2024. Through end-2025 IEMG returned 34.17% from publication versus SPY 30.05%, while EWZ returned 26.54%. The proposed catalyst had partial regional support; it was not uniformly successful across cheap emerging markets.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

framework_lessons: Set business invalidation tests before averaging down.
assessment: The explicit review of losers improves accountability. CVS ultimately showed both an insurance earnings rebound and acquisition impairment, warranting mixed assessment. BMY patent risk materialized alongside new-product growth. OZK survived profitably but its loan cushions did not prevent losses.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
